entities.name: ParkingLot
responsibilities: Assign spots to vehicles on entry
Issue tickets and track active tickets

entities.name: ParkingFloor
responsibilities: Hold the spots on one floor
Count free spots per spot type

entities.name: ParkingSpot
responsibilities: Know its size and whether it is occupied

entities.name: SpotType
responsibilities: List spot sizes: MOTORCYCLE, COMPACT, LARGE

entities.name: Vehicle
responsibilities: Expose the licence plate and the spot size it needs

entities.name: Ticket
responsibilities: Record vehicle, spot and entry time

entities.name: SpotAllocator
responsibilities: Find the first free spot that fits the vehicle, lowest floor first

entities.name: PricingStrategy
responsibilities: Calculate the fee for a ticket

entities.name: HourlyPricing
responsibilities: Charge per started hour with a rate per spot type

patterns.name: Strategy
patterns.why: Pricing rules change often (weekend rates, EV surcharge) and should not require editing ParkingLot.

keyFlows:
Park: the entry gate calls ParkingLot.parkVehicle(vehicle) -> SpotAllocator.allocate(vehicle) scans floors for a free spot that fits -> spot.assign(vehicle) -> new Ticket(vehicle, spot, now). If nothing fits, throw LotFullException.
Exit: ParkingLot.unparkVehicle(ticket) -> PricingStrategy.calculateFee(ticket, now) -> spot.release().
tradeOffs: Singleton ParkingLot is easy to reach from every gate.
assumptions: One vehicle per spot. A vehicle never uses a larger spot than it needs.
